channels.name: Build
channels.spec:
Goal: Build, test, and ship functional websites, web applications, or interactive games.

## Verticals
- **Websites & Landing Pages:** Modern static/SSR sites (Astro, Vite + React, or Next.js), TypeScript, Tailwind CSS, responsive mobile-first layouts, accessible markup, SEO meta tags, and high-performance assets.
- **Web Applications:** Vite + React + TypeScript or Next.js. Clean component architecture, state management, authentication and PostgreSQL via Supabase, API integration, and robust error handling.
- **Games:** HTML5 Canvas, Phaser, or WebGL with TypeScript. Smooth 60fps game loops, keyboard/touch/gamepad controls, sprite animations, sound effects, particle systems, collision physics, and score persistence.

## Execution Principles
- Two-process architecture where applicable (Vite frontend on 5173, thin Express/Hono backend on 3001). Never expose secrets in client bundles.
- Keep dependencies lean, typed, and modern. Deliver working runnable code, not partial snippets.
- Provide clear preview URLs, setup instructions, and deployment configurations.

## Agents
Claude Code and Cursor implement the code, assets, and project architecture. GitHub manages repositories and releases. Supabase provides database and auth services. Cloudflare handles edge hosting and routing.

## Done when
The website, app, or game runs locally or in preview, meets all requirements in the brief, passes typechecks, and provides an engaging, polished user experience.

channels.name: Create
channels.spec:
Goal: Produce compelling visual media, video productions, and presentation slide decks.

## Verticals
- **Visuals & Graphics:** High-resolution product mockups, brand assets, social media graphics, SVG diagrams, UI illustration kits, and marketing visual banners with cohesive style guides and color palettes.
- **Videos & Storyboards:** Comprehensive video production packages including scene-by-scene storyboards, visual direction cues, shot angles, timing markers, voiceover audio scripts, and motion graphics briefs.
- **Pitch Decks & Presentations:** Polished, persuasive slide decks (10–15 slides) structured for investors, keynotes, or client pitches. Clean narrative arc (Problem, Solution, Market, Product, Traction, Business Model, Team, Ask).

## Creative Standards
- Cohesive visual identity: consistent typography, color harmonies, and brand motifs across all deliverables.
- High attention to clarity: reduce cognitive load, lead with strong headlines, and support with concrete proof points or visual evidence.
- Include structured source files (SVG/HTML/React/Markdown) so assets can be rendered, customized, or exported to PDF/Keynote.

## Agents
Claude Code generates visual assets, code diagrams, and slide layouts. Fish Audio creates professional voiceover narration and audio guides. Notion organizes campaign materials and copy drafts. GitHub version-controls digital assets and presentation code.

## Done when
Visual assets are ready for publishing, video storyboards have timing and audio scripts, and slide decks have complete narrative flow and professional design.

starterPrompts.prompt: Design and generate high-impact visual assets: create product mockup scenes, SVG icons, brand style guide elements, and social graphics. @claude-code can generate the design assets and code.

starterPrompts.prompt: Create a compelling 60-second video script and scene-by-scene storyboard with visual direction, pacing, and voiceover copy. @fish-audio can generate voiceovers. @claude-code can structure the script and assets.

starterPrompts.label: Pitch deck & slides
starterPrompts.description: 10-slide investor or keynote deck with structured narrative
starterPrompts.prompt: Create a professional 10-slide presentation deck with compelling narrative structure, problem/solution breakdown, market size analysis, and slide copy ready to present.

channels.name: Grow
channels.description: Ads, social media, and cold outreach
channels.spec:
Goal: Scale user acquisition, pipeline generation, and brand visibility through growth channels.

## Verticals
- **Paid Ads:** High-converting multi-platform ad copy and creative briefs (Google Search & Display, Meta Facebook/Instagram, LinkedIn, X/Twitter). Multiple angle variations (pain-point, feature-driven, social proof, FOMO), compelling CTAs, and A/B testing frameworks.
- **Social Media:** Organic distribution engine with a 30-day content calendar, viral thread hooks, carousel outlines, thought leadership posts, engagement questions, and platform-specific formatting.
- **Cold Outreach:** High-reply B2B outbound campaigns. 4-step sequence (initial hook, case study proof, soft bump, breakup), personalized opening lines, objection pre-empting, clear calls-to-action, and follow-up cadence.

## Conversion Principles
- Audience-first messaging: speak directly to customer pains, avoid jargon, and emphasize quantifiable ROI.
- Data-driven experimentation: test headlines, value propositions, and delivery timing with measurable KPIs.
- Deliverability & compliance: ensure email sequences follow CAN-SPAM/GDPR practices with clean domain warmup guidance via Resend.

## Agents
Claude Code drafts copy, campaign strategies, and audience targeting matrices. Firecrawl gathers competitor messaging and market intelligence. Resend guides email delivery and outreach infrastructure. Notion maintains content calendars and lead lists. Slack coordinates campaign alerts.

## Done when
Campaign copy, social calendars, and outreach sequences are complete with variants, target personas, and clear action steps for launch.

starterPrompts.label: Paid ad campaigns
starterPrompts.description: High-converting copy and creative briefs for Google, Meta, and X
starterPrompts.prompt: Develop high-converting ad copy and creative variants for Google Search, Meta, and LinkedIn ads targeting our ideal customer profile with A/B test hooks and calls to action.

starterPrompts.label: Social media calendar
starterPrompts.description: 30-day multi-channel content plan with viral hooks and threads
starterPrompts.prompt: Create a 30-day social media content strategy and post calendar for X/Twitter and LinkedIn, including viral hooks, educational threads, and engagement CTAs.

starterPrompts.label: Cold outreach sequence
starterPrompts.description: Personalized 4-step B2B email sequence with follow-ups
starterPrompts.prompt: Write a personalized 4-step B2B cold email outreach sequence with compelling subject lines, value propositions, objection handling, and follow-up templates. @resend can assist with email deliverability.
